verdict.rationale: AngelList Equity documents in-platform legal e-signing of grants that automatically updates the cap table. Share securities are generated automatically on transfers, and stakeholders accept and acknowledge instruments by e-signature, so the core flow exists. However, the evidence never explicitly describes electronic share certificates or a persistent certificate-to-cap-table-entry link, and the update FAQ indicates customers are being moved to other cap table providers. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of electronic share certificate issuance (not just option grants), evidence of a permanent link between each certificate and its cap table entry, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can issue electronic share certificates that are legally signed in-platform and permanently linked to the cap table entry they represent

citations.quote: allows the company and recipients to legally sign grants without the need for another e-signature tool. It also automatically updates your cap table
